name: Rustwake
summary: Rustwake is a first-person restoration simulator set at North Cape Harbor. The player cleans rust and barnacles from a fallen mechanical lighthouse keeper and the slipways around it, choosing which surfaces to tackle first. Recovered iron upgrades the pressure washer or pays for equipment such as climbing spiders, drones and an articulated wash boat. The project ends when the restored giant can stand and light the bay again.
